channel.title: Peptis Publication
channel.description: Education from original trials on lean mass, protein, training, skin and maintenance during GLP-1 weight loss. Not medical advice.

item.title: Does Ozempic cause muscle loss?
item.description: GLP-1 weight loss can include lean tissue. Lean mass is not muscle. SURMOUNT 1 found about 25% of lost weight was lean mass. Education only.

item.title: What is lean mass vs muscle mass?
item.description: DEXA lean mass includes water, organs, connective tissue and bone mineral, not just skeletal muscle. Track function with the scan. Education only.

item.title: How much protein do you need on a GLP-1?
item.description: Reviews support about 1.2 to 1.6 g/kg/day for many active weight-loss contexts. The weight denominator needs individual guidance. Education only.

item.title: What is a two-day strength plan during weight loss?
item.description: Resistance training has the strongest evidence for retaining lean tissue in general weight loss. Two full-body sessions are a start. Education only.

item.title: What happens after stopping semaglutide?
item.description: STEP 1 extension participants regained about two thirds of prior weight loss a year after stopping. That is chronic biology, not failure. Education only.

item.title: Does collagen prevent loose skin after weight loss?
item.description: High-quality collagen trials do not show a clear skin benefit. No supplement is shown to prevent loose skin during GLP-1 weight loss. Education only.
